page.overview:
What is Clefairy?

Clefairy is a small, round, pink, star-shaped Pokémon. Its hands have two white claws and a thumb. Its ears are short and pointy with dark tips. It has a long, curled tail and swirly hair and pink cheeks. On its back, it has small wings.

Clefairy are very timid and rarely appears in front of humans. But they are also very clever, and there are awareness among social and religious groups. Clefairy is a nocturnal Pokémon, and sometimes one will come out during the full moon to dance.

Clefairy can jump very high, as seen in the anime, and can hear very well. This is often the reason why they are hard to find. A Clefairy collects moonlight in its wings and uses it to fly.

Clefairy evolves from Cleffa if leveled up with high friendship and evolves into Clefable if it touches a Moon Stone.
